subject: Apollo crewed lunar-landing proposition and post-1972 replication gap
purpose: Stress-test OGI v0.3 on adjudicating a contested historical-technological proposition before explaining its downstream anomaly
originating_observation: Humans often imitate and escalate difficult demonstrated achievements, yet no human has landed on the Moon since 1972.
governing_questions: Did humans land on the Moon as claimed?
What does each evidence class actually establish?
Which evidence streams are institutionally independent?
Can alternative staged models explain the joint evidence field without unsupported bridges?
If crewed landings are sufficiently warranted, what explains the post-1972 replication gap?

first_pass_failure.summary: The first pass explained the lunar-return gap using program shutdown and political-field variables before adjudicating the antecedent crewed-landing proposition.

triggers: Apollo 11 footpad geometry and descent sequence
material_updates: Nixon full-call propagation analysis corrected: 2.56 s is lunar radio round-trip only, not complete White House call path
Chandrayaan-2 Apollo 11 evidence split into peer-reviewed description, displayed ISRO-attributed image, and raw PRADAN product rather than compressed into one retrieval state
Specific rover-track morphology remains NOT_ADJUDICATED because the alleged image is not present in the current attachments

reopen_history.trigger: Researcher objected that a paper asserting an image exists is not the same evidentiary rung as showing the image

prohibited_shortcuts: NASA evidence streams are all counted as institutionally independent
Physical equipment on the Moon automatically proves human emplacement
A non-falsifiable alternative receives equal warrant merely because it cannot be logically excluded
The post-1972 gap is explained before Apollo itself is adjudicated
A citation describing an image is treated as retrieval and inspection of that image

subject_finding.summary: Several popular technical anomalies inspected in this case have direct engineering explanations. Independent tracking, laser ranging, surface hardware/experiments, returned lunar samples, orbital site consistency and non-US observations form a convergent evidence field. Reopen 1A corrected the non-US image leg by separating the peer-reviewed description of the OHRC frame, a displayed image attributed to ISRO and sourced to a 2021 ISRO presentation, and the still-unretrieved raw PRADAN product/pixel chain. No single inspected item is a self-sufficient proof of people on the surface. The crewed-landing model currently requires substantially fewer unsupported auxiliary assumptions than staged alternatives. The post-1972 crewed-surface gap remains a separate legitimate anomaly.

research_debt: Obtain and time the original Nixon Library WHCA recording at waveform level to measure end-of-speech / reply turnaround without broadcast edits
Retrieve the exact PRADAN product ID, calibrated binary and XML geometry for the 2 April 2021 Chandrayaan-2 OHRC Apollo 11 frame and reproduce the displayed image from raw data
Obtain the exact rover-track photograph described by the researcher and compare its pixels against documented LRV wheel/tread geometry
Audit sample custody and independent international laboratory analyses as a separate provenance staircase
Run explicit alternative-model comparison for staging variants rather than treating moon-hoax claims as one model
Conduct second-stage inquiry into the 54-year crewed lunar landing replication gap
